description: This file defines the AppStore class managing application state, synchronization, and UI interactions for the Notesnook project. It includes methods for toggling UI modes, handling sync operations, managing notices, and reacting to network/page visibility changes.

classes.name: AppStore
classes.description: Manages application state, synchronization, UI toggles, and reacts to network/page visibility events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the store, sets up event subscriptions, and triggers initial sync.

methods.name: setHiddenColors
methods.description: Updates hidden color items in settings and state.

methods.name: setHiddenRoutes
methods.description: Updates hidden route items in settings and state.

methods.name: toggleListPane
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the list pane.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes data from various stores and updates navigation items.

methods.name: refreshNavItems
methods.description: Refreshes shortcuts and color items for navigation.

methods.name: toggleFocusMode
methods.description: Toggles focus mode, exits fullscreen, and focuses the editor.

methods.name: toggleAutoSync
methods.description: Toggles automatic synchronization setting.

methods.name: toggleSync
methods.description: Enables or disables manual sync.

methods.name: toggleRealtimeSync
methods.description: Toggles real-time synchronization.

methods.name: setIsVaultCreated
methods.description: Sets the vault creation status.

methods.name: setNotices
methods.description: Adds or updates notices.

methods.name: dismissNotices
methods.description: Removes notices.

methods.name: addToShortcuts
methods.description: Adds or removes a shortcut for a notebook or tag.

methods.name: updateLastSynced
methods.description: Updates the last synced timestamp.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization with options for full or partial sync, handles conflicts and errors.

methods.name: abortSync
methods.description: Stops ongoing sync and updates status.

methods.name: updateSyncStatus
methods.description: Updates the sync status indicator.

methods.name: isSyncing
methods.description: Returns whether a sync operation is in progress.

methods.name: setNavigationTab
methods.description: Sets the current navigation tab.
